title: Did Sumerian Records just sign Slaughter to Prevail?
author: Dakota G.
contentHtml:
Sumerian Records posted a short 15-second video entitled “#Sumerian2016” this morning on Facebook with a teaser for new music from an as-yet-unrevealed band. Funny thing is that it doesn’t appear to be a band Sumerian ever had on their roster. Check the video out for yourselves, but it sounds suspiciously like Slaughter to Prevail, whose signing could be a huge move for Sumerian. Slaughter to Prevail was founded in 2014 but quickly gained quite the fanbase after dropping their debut Chapters of Misery.

Where do you stand on this? Have you watched the video, and do you think that it could possibly be Slaughter to Prevail?

For all things metal keep it locked here at Metal Lifestyle.

​- Dakota G.
